One door in

Everyone who isn’t ready for a discovery call today leaves with nothing, and you have no way to reach them again.

Sound familiar?

New person, new start. So why does it end up feeling the same?

  • A few months in, the new relationship starts to feel a lot like the last one.
  • When a partner pulls away, your body reacts before your head can catch up.
  • You’ve asked yourself “why do I keep attracting this?” more times than you can count.
  • You’ve read about it and you understand it. It still keeps happening.

Here’s what you’ll learn

Five things we’ll cover in 60 minutes

Where the pattern starts

Why we’re drawn to what feels familiar, even when it isn’t good for us, and how your wounded patterns show up in who you choose.

What your body does when an old wound is triggered

How to notice the pull in the moment, so you can respond instead of react.

What to say when a partner pulls away

Simple words that keep you connected without chasing or shutting down.

Masculine and feminine energy

How the balance between the two shapes the way you give, receive and attract.

How to choose differently next time

A clear way to spot the pattern early and take one different step.

Video ad scripts

Script 1 · “Same partner, different face”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Ever notice how every relationship ends up feeling like the last one?”

Body

“Different city, different person, same ending. It isn’t bad luck. Most of us are drawn to what feels familiar, even when it doesn’t feel good. Once you can see the pattern, you can start choosing differently.”

CTA

“I’m teaching exactly how in a live 60-minute masterclass. It’s $17. Tap Sign up to grab your seat.”

Shot: talking to camera, white shirt, warm light, same setup as your profile photo.

Script 2 · “When they pull away”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Here’s what to say when a partner starts pulling away.”

Body

“Most of us do one of two things. We chase, or we shut down. Both push the other person further away. There’s a third option, and it starts with noticing what’s happening in your body before you reply.”

CTA

“I break it all down in my live masterclass, Why You Keep Attracting the Same Partner. Tap Sign up.”

Shot: your text-card style. Aqua background, black serif title on screen, cut to you talking.

Script 3 · “Masculine and feminine”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“A friend asked me at a bar: why do I keep attracting the same person?”

Body

“Here’s what I told them. A lot of it comes down to the balance of masculine and feminine energy we bring into a relationship, and the patterns we learnt long before we started dating.”

CTA

“I go deeper in a live 60-minute class. $17, replay included. Tap Sign up below.”

Shot: walk-and-talk, or retreat b-roll, captions in white with one aqua keyword.
